FP.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' /*到期还本*100*/ THEN ROUND(psp.AMOUNT * fcp.CASH_AMT, 2) WHEN FP.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F16', 'F24') /*产品到期*/ THEN psp.AMOUNT ELSE ROUND(psp.AMOUNT * fcp.CASH_AMT / NVL(fcp.CASH_BASEAMT, 1) / 1, 2) END AS CASHFLOW FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION psp LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp /*产品组合*/ ON psp.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp /*资产付息计划*/ ON fcp.FINPROD_ID = psp.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp /*资产标的*/ ON fp.FINPROD_ID = psp.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD PRODADD /*产品附属表*/ ON ( PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID = PRODADD.PORTFOLIO_ID OR pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID = PRODADD.PORTFOLIO_ID) LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT PROD /*产品要素*/ ON PRODADD.FINPROD_ID = PROD.FINPROD_ID WHERE PROD.VDATE <= FCP.MDATE /*过滤掉产品陈立日之前的计划*/ AND FCP.PAY_DATE = to_date(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd')+1 AND psp.CDATE = to_date(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd') AND psp.AMOUNT > 0 AND psp.hoding_type = '03' AND FP.FINPROD_TYPE2 NOT IN ('F16','F24') union all select '' PS, fp.mdate, psp.portfolio_id, psp.finprod_id, FP.FINPROD_TYPE2 CASHFLOWTYPE, '' CASH_TYPE, psp.amount * -1 CASHFLOW from ptl_sec_position psp left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = psp.FINPROD_ID where (FP.FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F16', 'F24')) and psp.CDATE = to_date(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd') - 1 and fp.mdate = select FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, FINPROD_NAME text from PA_PRD_ISSUE_SCHEDULE where PROD_REGIST_CODE IS NOT NULL
and (FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or FINPROD_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))
union select FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID code, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_NAME shortName from FIN_PRODUCT, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD where FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID and FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodTypeProd} and FIN_PRODUCT.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL
and (FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))
and (FIN_PRODUCT.PROFIT_TYPE in ('01','02','03'))

select distinct product.prod_manager id,users.REAL_NAME text from FIN_PRODUCT_ADD product left join sys_user users on product.prod_manager = users.USER_NAME where prod_manager is not null
and (prod_manager like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))
